quduri.meaning: menstruation: the blood that flows from the womb of a woman who is free of illness and not a minor
quduri.source: Mukhtaṣar al-Qudūrī — Kitāb al-Ṭahārah: ḥayḍ, istiḥāḍah and nifās — class notes 2026-10-27

quduri.text: <bdi>الحَيْض</bdi> lasts at least {{c1::3 days and nights}} and at most {{c2::10 days and nights}}; bleeding outside that range is {{c3::<bdi>الاِسْتِحَاضَة</bdi>}}
quduri.source: Mukhtaṣar al-Qudūrī — Kitāb al-Ṭahārah: ḥayḍ, istiḥāḍah and nifās — class notes 2026-10-27

quduri.front: Bleeding like ḥayḍ lasts two and a half days and then stops. What happens to the prayers she missed?
quduri.back: She makes them up: under 3 days it wasn't ḥayḍ, so the prayers were owed
quduri.source: Mukhtaṣar al-Qudūrī — Kitāb al-Ṭahārah: ḥayḍ, istiḥāḍah and nifās — class notes 2026-10-27

quduri.front: What are the limits on <bdi>الطُّهْر</bdi> (ṭuhr), the purity between two cycles?
quduri.back: At least 15 days, and no maximum
quduri.source: Mukhtaṣar al-Qudūrī — Kitāb al-Ṭahārah: ḥayḍ, istiḥāḍah and nifās — class notes 2026-10-27

quduri.front: How do the Ḥanafīs treat the colour of the blood?
quduri.back: They don't distinguish between colours. Red, yellow or murky, it's ḥayḍ within the days of ḥayḍ, until she sees pure white.
quduri.source: Mukhtaṣar al-Qudūrī — Kitāb al-Ṭahārah: ḥayḍ, istiḥāḍah and nifās — class notes 2026-10-27

quduri.front: What is a gap of purity within the days of ḥayḍ treated as?
quduri.back: As flowing blood: a brief stop during the cycle is still ḥayḍ
quduri.source: Mukhtaṣar al-Qudūrī — Kitāb al-Ṭahārah: ḥayḍ, istiḥāḍah and nifās — class notes 2026-10-27

quduri.text: The rulings of ḥayḍ: {{c1::prayer drops, with no make-up}}; {{c2::fasting is unlawful but still owed, so it's made up}}; {{c3::no entering the masjid}}; {{c4::no ṭawāf}}; {{c5::no intimacy}}; {{c6::no reciting the Qurʾān}}
quduri.source: Mukhtaṣar al-Qudūrī — Kitāb al-Ṭahārah: ḥayḍ, istiḥāḍah and nifās — class notes 2026-10-27

quduri.front: During ḥayḍ she neither prays nor fasts. Why does she make up only the fasts?
quduri.back: Fasting is only unlawful during ḥayḍ: the obligation remains, so it's made up. The obligation of prayer drops altogether.
quduri.source: Mukhtaṣar al-Qudūrī — Kitāb al-Ṭahārah: ḥayḍ, istiḥāḍah and nifās — class notes 2026-10-27

quduri.front: Besides a woman in ḥayḍ, who may not enter the masjid?
quduri.back: A person in major ritual impurity (<bdi>الحَدَث الأَكْبَر</bdi>)
quduri.source: Mukhtaṣar al-Qudūrī — Kitāb al-Ṭahārah: ḥayḍ, istiḥāḍah and nifās — class notes 2026-10-27

quduri.front: What are the two reasons a woman in ḥayḍ may not perform ṭawāf?
quduri.back: It takes place in the masjid, and it requires ritual purity
quduri.source: Mukhtaṣar al-Qudūrī — Kitāb al-Ṭahārah: ḥayḍ, istiḥāḍah and nifās — class notes 2026-10-27

quduri.front: For a woman in ḥayḍ or a person in major ritual impurity, what counts as reciting the Qurʾān?
quduri.back: Saying it with the lips and tongue
quduri.source: Mukhtaṣar al-Qudūrī — Kitāb al-Ṭahārah: ḥayḍ, istiḥāḍah and nifās — class notes 2026-10-27

quduri.front: In the Ḥanafī school, what may a woman in ḥayḍ still say from the Qurʾān?
quduri.back: Verses said as duʿāʾ or dhikr rather than as recitation, such as Āyat al-Kursī
quduri.source: Mukhtaṣar al-Qudūrī — Kitāb al-Ṭahārah: ḥayḍ, istiḥāḍah and nifās — class notes 2026-10-27

quduri.front: What did al-Ṭaḥāwī allow a woman in ḥayḍ to recite, and what is the relied-upon Ḥanafī view?
quduri.back: Less than a verse. The relied-upon view forbids even that when it's meant as recitation.
quduri.source: Mukhtaṣar al-Qudūrī — Kitāb al-Ṭahārah: ḥayḍ, istiḥāḍah and nifās — class notes 2026-10-27

quduri.front: Which exception do the Mālikīs and most modern Ḥanafīs make to the ban on reciting during ḥayḍ?
quduri.back: A teacher or student of the Qurʾān may recite. The exception doesn't extend to major ritual impurity.
quduri.source: Mukhtaṣar al-Qudūrī — Kitāb al-Ṭahārah: ḥayḍ, istiḥāḍah and nifās — class notes 2026-10-27

quduri.front: Why can the teacher-or-student exception for reciting during ḥayḍ be read broadly?
quduri.back: It's not wrong to say every Muslim is a student of the Qurʾān, which essentially opens the door
quduri.source: Mukhtaṣar al-Qudūrī — Kitāb al-Ṭahārah: ḥayḍ, istiḥāḍah and nifās — class notes 2026-10-27

quduri.front: How may a person in minor ritual impurity touch the muṣḥaf?
quduri.source: Mukhtaṣar al-Qudūrī — Kitāb al-Ṭahārah: ḥayḍ, istiḥāḍah and nifās — class notes 2026-10-27

quduri.front: When does intimacy become lawful after ḥayḍ stops?
quduri.back: If it stops before 10 days, once she takes a ghusl or a full prayer time passes over her. If it stops at 10 days, at once.
quduri.source: Mukhtaṣar al-Qudūrī — Kitāb al-Ṭahārah: ḥayḍ, istiḥāḍah and nifās — class notes 2026-10-27

quduri.meaning: irregular bleeding: bleeding like ḥayḍ that lasts under 3 days or over 10, or postnatal bleeding past 40 days
quduri.source: Mukhtaṣar al-Qudūrī — Kitāb al-Ṭahārah: ḥayḍ, istiḥāḍah and nifās — class notes 2026-10-27

quduri.front: What does istiḥāḍah take the ruling of, and what doesn't it prevent?
quduri.back: A constant nosebleed: it doesn't prevent prayer, fasting or intimacy
quduri.source: Mukhtaṣar al-Qudūrī — Kitāb al-Ṭahārah: ḥayḍ, istiḥāḍah and nifās — class notes 2026-10-27

quduri.front: Her bleeding goes past 10 days, and her known cycle is 6 days. How is it divided?
quduri.back: She goes back to her habit: days 1–6 are ḥayḍ and the rest is istiḥāḍah, so she makes up the prayers from day 7
quduri.source: Mukhtaṣar al-Qudūrī — Kitāb al-Ṭahārah: ḥayḍ, istiḥāḍah and nifās — class notes 2026-10-27

quduri.front: A girl starts bleeding at puberty and it never stops. How is it divided?
quduri.back: Her ḥayḍ is the first 10 days of each month, and the rest is istiḥāḍah. It's a rare illness.
quduri.source: Mukhtaṣar al-Qudūrī — Kitāb al-Ṭahārah: ḥayḍ, istiḥāḍah and nifās — class notes 2026-10-27

quduri.meaning: postnatal bleeding: the blood after childbirth
quduri.source: Mukhtaṣar al-Qudūrī — Kitāb al-Ṭahārah: ḥayḍ, istiḥāḍah and nifās — class notes 2026-10-27

quduri.text: <bdi>النِّفَاس</bdi> has {{c1::no minimum}} and a maximum of {{c2::40 days}}. Bleeding past that is {{c3::<bdi>الاِسْتِحَاضَة</bdi>}}, and so is bleeding {{c4::before the child comes out}}.
quduri.source: Mukhtaṣar al-Qudūrī — Kitāb al-Ṭahārah: ḥayḍ, istiḥāḍah and nifās — class notes 2026-10-27

quduri.front: With twins, when does nifās begin?
quduri.back: After the first child, according to al-Shaykhān (Abū Ḥanīfah and Abū Yūsuf); after the second, according to Muḥammad al-Shaybānī
quduri.source: Mukhtaṣar al-Qudūrī — Kitāb al-Ṭahārah: ḥayḍ, istiḥāḍah and nifās — class notes 2026-10-27

quduri.meaning: someone excused: one who can't keep wuḍūʾ long enough to pray, from constant bleeding, incontinence, a constant nosebleed or a wound that won't heal
quduri.source: Mukhtaṣar al-Qudūrī — Kitāb al-Ṭahārah: ḥayḍ, istiḥāḍah and nifās — class notes 2026-10-27

quduri.front: How does a maʿdhūr make wuḍūʾ, and when does it end?
quduri.back: One wuḍūʾ for each prayer time, which allows everything that needs minor purity. It ends when that prayer time ends.
quduri.source: Mukhtaṣar al-Qudūrī — Kitāb al-Ṭahārah: ḥayḍ, istiḥāḍah and nifās — class notes 2026-10-27
